content.body:
## What Is a Tax Guide and How Do I Use It

Tax guides are valuable tools put together to assist businesses in how Arvada treats taxation on a variety of subjects. The guides provide general tax information on popular subjects, with easy-to-understand explanations and relevant examples. The guides are not meant to replace the Arvada tax code and are not intended to be used for legal purposes. If you still have questions, need more information, or need assistance with a topic not listed here, please give us a call at **720-898-7100** and let us help you!
